text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Information minister says no stability in Gulf as long as Iraq's President Saddam stays in power.
- Active trade on Kuwait Stock Exchange.
- Foreign Minister Sheikh Sabah al-Ahmad al-Sabah stresses Kuwait's right to seek foreign military assistance for protection.

- Central Bank says 43 percent of the debtors involved in a plan to settle long-standing bad debts did not pay the second instalment due on Septemeber 6. The original value of the debt owed by the private sector to the state stood at $20 billion.
- Jordan's prime minister says Kuwait has the right to take all necessay measures to deter aggression.
- Parliament in open-ended session due to Iraq crisis.
